task_name: World 112 Task A  -  Fractional COO 3PL Physical Inventory vs. Stale Shopify Export & Factory PO Advance Cutoff
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional COO & CFO Inventory, 3PL & Job-Board Operations review using the world files (`cfo_coo_inventory_3pl_and_spv_cutoff_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Identifies that the unadjusted 9/28 Shopify export reports 752,000 units ($13,836,800.00 at $18.40 SKU cost), inflated by 230,000 phantom units at closed PP-AZ Warehouse ($4,232,000.00) and 493,000 unadjusted cumulative units at Maryland Warehouse ($9,071,200.00).

Computes verified GAAP Ending Inventory as 200,452 units and $3,688,521.00 ($3,154,921.00 across 171,452 sellable units at Eastern Fulfillment MD 3PL plus $533,600.00 across 29,000 active retail store units).

Quantifies the $10,148,279.00 inventory overstatement (551,548 phantom units) avoided by using the Eastern Fulfillment 3PL physical count ($3,688,521.00) instead of the raw Shopify export ($13,836,800.00).
Computes total September unreceived factory PO deposits as $684,062.62 (WIRE-9901 for $220,000.00 to KNT, WIRE-9904 for $325,000.00 to Bohao, and WIRE-9909 for $139,062.62 to Spring Air & Henrial).

Retains the $684,062.62 of Spring 2027 / Q4 factory advances in 1310 Prepaid Inventory Deposits rather than expensing to COGS or adding to on-hand 3PL inventory because goods were unreceived and Bohao's final balance was not paid until 2026-10-05.
Explains why raw Shopify inventory exports cannot be booked directly to the Balance Sheet without 3PL physical warehouse reconciliation and unit-cost mapping.
Separates on-hand sellable 3PL/store inventory ($3,688,521.00) from in-production vendor deposits ($684,062.62) on the CFO/COO Balance Sheet.
Enforces the COO inventory conservation gate before locking YTD landed COGS.
